description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeAttachmentController class, which handles file-related HTTP requests for employee attachments in the OrangeHRM application. It extends an abstract controller and interacts with services and entities to serve attachment files based on request parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller class handling employee attachment file requests, extending AbstractFileController to provide file download services based on employee number and attachment ID.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentService
methods.description: Initializes and returns an instance of EmployeeAttachmentService, implementing lazy loading.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP requests to serve an employee attachment file if accessible; returns a bad request response otherwise.
